_about: Which entries in a /players/{tag} 'troops' list are pets or siege machines, and which are super troops (boosted copies of a base troop, left out of army progress). The API puts all of them in one list with no type field. A name not listed here counts as a troop. Village 'home' only.
source: Claude's knowledge of the in-game unit names, not checked against a live response. Check the first real profile pass: any pet or siege machine that shows under troops needs adding here.
